items.headline: Physics Nobel 2021 for three climate-and-complexity scientists
items.detail: The 2021 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to Syukuro Manabe and Klaus Hasselmann together with Giorgio Parisi, as announced in October 2021.
examFacts: Laureates: Syukuro Manabe, Klaus Hasselmann, Giorgio Parisi

items.headline: Chemistry Nobel 2021 for List and MacMillan
items.detail: The 2021 Nobel Prize in Chemistry was shared by Benjamin List and David MacMillan, as announced in October 2021.

items.headline: Peace Nobel for journalists Ressa and Muratov
items.detail: Journalists Maria Ressa (Philippines/US) and Dmitry Muratov (Russia) won the 2021 Nobel Peace Prize, announced on October 8, 'for their efforts to safeguard freedom of expression, which is a precondition for democracy and lasting peace'.

items.headline: Tata Group wins bid to buy back Air India
items.detail: On October 8, 2021 the government accepted the Tata Group's winning bid of Rs 18,000 crore (about USD 1.9 billion) for Air India, its low-cost arm Air India Express and 50% of AISATS, ending the airline's decades of state ownership after the handover on January 27, 2022.
examFacts: Buyer: Tata Group; price Rs 18,000 crore

items.headline: India lift SAFF Championship for record 8th time
items.detail: India won the 2021 SAFF Championship in Maldives, beating Nepal 3-0 in the October 16 final at Male for a record eighth title. Captain Sunil Chhetri finished top scorer with five goals and took the MVP award.
examFacts: Record 8th title; Chhetri top scorer and MVP

items.headline: Kannada star Puneeth Rajkumar dies at 46
items.detail: Popular Kannada actor Puneeth Rajkumar, son of thespian Dr. Rajkumar, died of a heart attack in Bengaluru on October 29, 2021 at the age of 46; he had won the National Film Award as a child artist and was posthumously honoured with the Karnataka Ratna in 2022.

quiz.q: The 2021 Nobel Peace Prize was shared by Maria Ressa and Dmitry Muratov for:
quiz.solution: The two journalists won for efforts to safeguard freedom of expression, a precondition for democracy and lasting peace.

quiz.q: Maria Ressa, 2021 Nobel Peace laureate, hails from which country (with US citizenship)?
quiz.solution: Ressa is from the Philippines; Muratov is from Russia.

quiz.q: The 2021 Nobel Prize in Physics went to Syukuro Manabe, Klaus Hasselmann and:
quiz.solution: The three shared the 2021 Physics Nobel.

quiz.q: Who won the 2021 Nobel Prize in Chemistry?
quiz.solution: List and MacMillan shared the 2021 Chemistry Nobel.

quiz.q: India's 2021 SAFF Championship final win over Nepal was its title number:
quiz.solution: The 3-0 win in Male on October 16, 2021 was India's record eighth SAFF title.

quiz.q: Who was the top scorer and MVP of the 2021 SAFF Championship?
quiz.solution: India captain Sunil Chhetri scored five goals and was named MVP.

quiz.q: The government accepted the Tata Group's Rs 18,000 crore bid for Air India in:
quiz.solution: The winning bid was accepted on October 8, 2021; the handover completed on January 27, 2022.

quiz.q: Kannada actor Puneeth Rajkumar, who died in October 2021, was posthumously honoured with:
quiz.solution: He received the Karnataka Ratna posthumously in 2022.

items.headline: PM announces net-zero by 2070 at COP26 Glasgow
items.detail: At the COP26 climate summit in Glasgow (October 31 - November 13, 2021), Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced India would reach net-zero carbon emissions by 2070 - the first such target date in India's climate policy - and draw half of its energy needs from renewable sources by 2030.
examFacts: Half of energy needs renewable by 2030

items.headline: Australia win maiden T20 World Cup in UAE
items.detail: Australia beat New Zealand by eight wickets in the final of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup on November 14, 2021 (October 17 - November 14, UAE and Oman) to win the title for the first time; Mitchell Marsh was Player of the Match and India exited in the Super 12 stage.

items.headline: INS Vela, fourth Scorpene submarine, commissioned
items.detail: The Indian Navy commissioned INS Vela, the fourth Kalvari-class (Scorpene) submarine built under Project 75 at Mazagon Dock, Mumbai, on November 25, 2021, in the presence of Navy Chief Admiral Karambir Singh.

items.headline: WHO names Omicron a variant of concern
items.detail: On November 26, 2021 the WHO designated the SARS-CoV-2 lineage B.1.1.529, first reported from South Africa on November 24 and first detected in Botswana, as a variant of concern and named it 'Omicron'.

items.headline: Constitution Day observed on November 26
items.detail: Constitution Day (Samvidhan Divas, also National Law Day) is observed every November 26, marking the Constituent Assembly's adoption of the Constitution in 1949; the observance began in 2015.

quiz.q: India's net-zero carbon emissions target announced at COP26 Glasgow is the year:
quiz.solution: PM Modi announced the 2070 net-zero goal - India's first - at COP26 in November 2021.

quiz.q: Which country won its first ICC Men's T20 World Cup in November 2021?
quiz.solution: Australia beat New Zealand by 8 wickets in the November 14, 2021 final for a maiden title.

quiz.q: INS Vela, commissioned in November 2021, is which class of submarine?
quiz.solution: It is the fourth Kalvari-class Scorpene submarine, built under Project 75 at Mazagon Dock.

quiz.q: The WHO declared the Omicron variant a 'variant of concern' on:
quiz.solution: The B.1.1.529 lineage, first reported from South Africa, was designated on November 26, 2021.

quiz.q: Constitution Day in India commemorates the Constitution's adoption by the Constituent Assembly on:
quiz.solution: It marks the November 26, 1949 adoption; the Constitution came into force on January 26, 1950.

items.headline: Sindhu finishes runner-up at BWF World Tour Finals
items.detail: P. V. Sindhu lost the 2021 BWF World Tour Finals women's singles final to South Korea's An Se-young, taking her second silver medal at the year-end badminton championships.

items.headline: CDS Bipin Rawat dies in helicopter crash
items.detail: General Bipin Rawat, India's first Chief of Defence Staff, died on December 8, 2021 when an Indian Air Force Mi-17 helicopter crashed near Coonoor in Tamil Nadu's Nilgiris district. His wife Madhulika and 11 others also died; the sole initial survivor, Group Captain Varun Singh, died on December 15.
examFacts: Died: December 8, 2021, near Coonoor, Tamil Nadu
Earlier: 27th Chief of the Army Staff

items.headline: Year-long farm protests end as laws stand repealed
items.detail: The 2020-2021 farmers' protest formally ended on December 11, 2021 with farmers returning home, after Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced repeal of the three farm laws on November 19 and Parliament passed the Farm Laws Repeal Bill on November 29, 2021.
examFacts: Repeal Bill passed by Parliament: November 29, 2021

items.headline: Harnaaz Sandhu crowned Miss Universe 2021
items.detail: India's Harnaaz Sandhu won the 70th Miss Universe pageant at Eilat, Israel on December 13, 2021, becoming the third Indian to win the crown after Sushmita Sen (1994) and Lara Dutta (2000).

items.headline: DRDO flight-tests Pralay tactical ballistic missile
items.detail: DRDO successfully flight-tested the new Pralay quasi-ballistic short-range missile from Abdul Kalam Island on December 22, 2021, hitting a target at 400 km, with a second test the next day reaching 500 km with a heavier payload. The solid-fuelled, canisterised missile has a 150-500 km range class.

items.headline: James Webb Space Telescope launched on Ariane 5
items.detail: The James Webb Space Telescope - built by NASA with the European and Canadian space agencies - was launched on December 25, 2021 from Kourou, French Guiana on an Ariane 5 rocket, heading for a solar orbit near the Sun-Earth L2 point about 1.5 million km away as the infrared successor to Hubble.
examFacts: Orbit: Sun-Earth L2, about 1.5 million km from Earth

items.headline: Archbishop Desmond Tutu dies at 90
items.detail: Desmond Tutu, the South African Anglican archbishop and anti-apartheid campaigner who won the 1984 Nobel Peace Prize and chaired the Truth and Reconciliation Commission, died in Cape Town on December 26, 2021 at the age of 90.
examFacts: Chaired the Truth and Reconciliation Commission

quiz.q: General Bipin Rawat, who died in the December 8, 2021 helicopter crash, was India's first:
quiz.solution: He became the first Chief of Defence Staff on January 1, 2020 and died in a crash near Coonoor.

quiz.q: General Bipin Rawat's helicopter crashed near which hill town?
quiz.solution: The Mi-17 crashed near Coonoor in the Nilgiris district of Tamil Nadu.

quiz.q: The farmers' protest over the three farm laws formally ended on:
quiz.solution: Farmers withdrew on December 11, 2021 after Parliament passed the repeal bill on November 29.

quiz.q: Harnaaz Sandhu, crowned Miss Universe 2021, was India's Miss Universe title winner number:
quiz.solution: She is the third Indian winner after Sushmita Sen (1994) and Lara Dutta (2000).

quiz.q: The 70th Miss Universe pageant where Harnaaz Sandhu won was held in:
quiz.solution: The 70th edition was hosted at Eilat, Israel on December 13, 2021.

quiz.q: The James Webb Space Telescope was launched on December 25, 2021 from:
quiz.solution: An Ariane 5 rocket lifted it off from Kourou toward the Sun-Earth L2 point.

quiz.q: Desmond Tutu, who died in December 2021, won the Nobel Peace Prize in:
quiz.solution: The South African anti-apartheid archbishop received the 1984 Nobel Peace Prize.
